title: One Family’s Story of Survival and Loss in New Zealand

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报《DealBook》的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访几位商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I might just get everyone to start talking a little bit, I guess, and I'll see how it sounds.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能会让每个人都开始聊一聊，然后看看效果如何。

sentences.en: Perhaps you could tell me, I guess, when you got into Christchurch.
sentences.zh: 我想，也许你可以告诉我，你是何时到达克赖斯特彻奇的。

sentences.en: I met Abdullah and Haneen Alayan for the first time in Christchurch just over a week ago.
sentences.zh: 就在一个多星期前，我在克赖斯特彻奇第一次见到了阿卜杜拉和哈宁·阿拉扬。

sentences.en: Have you already talked about it?
sentences.zh: 你们已经谈过这个了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: They started telling me about what happened on the day of the terror attack in Christchurch at the mosque where their father and brother attended.
sentences.zh: 他们开始向我讲述克赖斯特彻奇恐怖袭击那天发生的事，当时袭击正发生在他俩的父亲和兄弟去的那座清真寺里。

sentences.en: It was a blur.
sentences.zh: 一切都一片模糊。

sentences.en: It was definitely a blur.
sentences.zh: 绝对是一片模糊。

sentences.en: They went straight to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们直奔医院。

sentences.en: Did we go to look for Dan after that?
sentences.zh: 在那之后我们去找过丹吗？

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 找过。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we did all the admin.
sentences.zh: 对，所以我们办好了所有的行政手续。

sentences.en: We went on a hunt to try and find him.
sentences.zh: 我们到处搜寻，试图找到他。

sentences.en: They knew that their dad had gone into surgery, so they knew that he had definitely been at the hospital at some point, but they hadn't heard about their brother.
sentences.zh: 他们知道父亲已经进了手术室，所以他们确信父亲在某个时候一定在医院里，但他们还没有弟弟的消息。

sentences.en: So they get to the hospital and their dad's name isn't anywhere and their brother's name isn't anywhere.
sentences.zh: 于是他们赶到医院，却到处都找不到父亲的名字，也到处都找不到弟弟的名字。

sentences.en: So they basically just start rushing from room to room on a hunt to try and find either of them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上就是开始在各个房间之间奔跑，到处搜寻他们俩的下落。

sentences.en: Because we couldn't.
sentences.zh: 因为我们找不到。

sentences.en: We'd been told by so many people that he'd seen, seen, came out of surgery, that he was okay.
sentences.zh: 很多人都告诉我们说他已经看过了、看过了、从手术室出来了，他没事。

sentences.en: We went to every ward and we couldn't find him anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们去了每一个病房，但到处都找不到他。

sentences.en: And he wasn't on the list either.
sentences.zh: 而且他也不在名单上。

sentences.en: There's this list at the hospital, and there's a number of anonymous patients on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 医院里有一份这样的名单，名单上有好几个匿名病人。

sentences.en: People who have been in surgery, but they don't have names for them.
sentences.zh: 那些做过手术但没有名字的病人。

sentences.en: So kind of earlier in the night, we were thinking, okay, well, if there's still 17 unconfirmed people,
sentences.zh: 所以在当晚早些时候，我们在想，好吧，如果还有 17 个未确认身份的人，

sentences.en: then there's hope that our brother's also here as one of those anonymous patients.
sentences.zh: 那么我们还有希望，觉得我们的弟弟可能也在这里，作为这些匿名病人之一。

sentences.en: Eventually, really late at night.
sentences.zh: 最终，在深夜时分。

sentences.en: After a kind of just chaotic back and forth with the police and whoever's handling it, they did end up finding out exactly who every single one of those anonymous patients were.
sentences.zh: 在与警察和负责处理此事的人经历了一番混乱的来回交涉后，他们最终确实查明了每一个匿名病人的确切身份。

sentences.en: And they read them out.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把名字念了出来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: A doctor who's part of the Muslim community in Christchurch comes into a waiting room and he essentially stands up and he starts reading the names.
sentences.zh: 一位克赖斯特彻奇穆斯林社区的医生走进候诊室，他基本上站起身来，开始宣读名字。

sentences.en: Sometimes there's one, two, three, four.
sentences.zh: 有时是一个、两个、三个、四个。

sentences.en: And halfway down, our dad was read out.
sentences.zh: 念到一半时，念到了我们父亲的名字。

sentences.en: Their father's name is called and they feel this sense of relief.
sentences.zh: 当听到他们父亲的名字被念出来时，他们感到如释重负。

sentences.en: But as more and more names are being called and they don't hear their brothers, they just start to feel their chests clench up.
sentences.zh: 但随着越来越多的名字被念出，却始终听不到弟弟的名字，他们的胸口开始紧缩。

sentences.en: Kept hearing more and more names getting read out.
sentences.zh: 不断听到越来越多的名字被念出来。

sentences.en: And the more that got read out, the more I knew.
sentences.zh: 念出的名字越多，我心里就越清楚。

sentences.en: Pretty much when the death toll climbed.
sentences.zh: 差不多就在死亡人数上升的时候。

sentences.en: I think it started at like nine when we first checked.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们第一次查看时大约是九人。

sentences.en: It went from six to nine to 30 to 45.
sentences.zh: 数字从六人变成九人、30人、45人。

sentences.en: To four to 49.
sentences.zh: 到四人、49人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The more it climbed, the more we realized what are the chances that they both needed.
sentences.zh: 数字每上升一次，我们就越发意识到，他们俩都需要帮助的几率有多大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then we just, we got to the end and our brother's name hadn't been read out.
sentences.zh: 然后我们，我们到了最后，也没有念到我们弟弟的名字。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Today, New Zealand is holding a national day of remembrance for the 50 people killed in the mosque shootings in Christchurch.
sentences.zh: 今天，新西兰为在克赖斯特彻奇清真寺枪击案中遇难的 50 人举行全国哀悼日。

sentences.en: The majority of the victims and their families were migrants or refugees from countries like Pakistan, India, Malaysia and Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 大多数遇难者及其家属是来自巴基斯坦、印度、马来西亚和印度尼西亚等国的移民或难民。

sentences.en: My colleague, Charlotte Cram MacLeod spent several days with one of the families.
sentences.zh: 我的同事夏洛特·克拉姆·麦克劳德和其中一个家庭度过了几天。
zh_words: 夏洛特·克拉姆·麦克劳德

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 3 月 29 日，星期五。

sentences.en: So the Alayan family, Muhammad is their father.
sentences.zh: 阿拉扬一家，父亲叫穆罕默德。

sentences.en: Maysoon is their mom.
sentences.zh: 母亲叫迈苏恩。

sentences.en: And the three kids are Atta, Hanin and Abdullah.
sentences.zh: 三个孩子分别是阿塔、哈宁和阿卜杜拉。

sentences.en: Atta was born in Kuwait City in 1985, which is where his parents were living at the time.
sentences.zh: 阿塔 1985 年出生于科威特城，他的父母当时正住在那里。

sentences.en: And what do they do?
sentences.zh: 他们是做什么的？

sentences.en: That's another good question.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个好问题。

sentences.en: Have you got an hour?
sentences.zh: 你有时间吗？

sentences.en: What don't they do?
sentences.zh: 有什么是他们不做的？

sentences.en: They're ethnically Palestinian and were both scientists.
sentences.zh: 他们是有巴勒斯坦血统的科学家夫妇。

sentences.en: I've heard so many accounts of mom juggling, raising her son and kind of lecturing and sorting out her PhD and bringing him into really unsafe labs.
sentences.zh: 我听过好多关于妈妈的故事：她一边兼顾抚养儿子，一边讲课、整理博士论文，还把他带进那些极其不安全的实验室里。

sentences.en: And they only came to New Zealand when a university here wanted beef research and that's what their father did.
sentences.zh: 他们只有在当地一所大学需要牛肉研究时才来到新西兰，而这正是他们父亲的老本行。

sentences.en: So that's when Christchurch became Atta's home in 1995.
sentences.zh: 所以，克赖斯特彻奇就是在 1995 年成为阿塔的家的。

sentences.en: He used to sit on a Macintosh.
sentences.zh: 他以前坐在一台麦金塔电脑前。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Macintosh computer.
sentences.zh: 麦金塔电脑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Those really old ones with the, what's that duck shooting game?
sentences.zh: 就是那种带屏幕的老式电脑，那个打鸭子游戏叫什么来着？

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定。

sentences.en: These old, old Macs that look like bricks.
sentences.zh: 这些老得不行的老款 Mac，长得像砖头一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Used to go and sit there while she was doing her work and just play that game.
sentences.zh: 他以前就坐在那里，趁她工作的时候玩那个游戏。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He was an only child for eight and a half years before his siblings came along.
sentences.zh: 在弟弟妹妹出生之前，他独生了八年半。

sentences.en: And it seems like he grew up as this sort of golden child.
sentences.zh: 他似乎是作为某种受宠的“金童”长大的。

sentences.en: He was really good at sport.
sentences.zh: 他非常擅长体育。

sentences.en: He scored an own goal once.
sentences.zh: 他曾经踢进过一个乌龙球。

sentences.en: And he was a goalkeeper.
sentences.zh: 而他是个守门员。

sentences.en: However, he also scored a goal from a goalkeeping position.
sentences.zh: 然而，他也曾在守门员的位置上进过球。

sentences.en: Which is incredible.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So when his parents first moved to Christchurch, his father was one of the leadership figures at the Elnor Mosque.
sentences.zh: 所以当他的父母刚搬到克赖斯特彻奇时，他的父亲是努尔清真寺的领导人物之一。

sentences.en: But the mosque was integral to kind of bringing in our life.
sentences.zh: 但清真寺对融入我们的生活起到了至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: It was beyond childhood.
sentences.zh: 那超越了童年。

sentences.en: I was probably there more than most every week, you know.
sentences.zh: 我每周在那里的时间可能比大多数人都多，你知道的。

sentences.en: How did Atta wrestle with that in high school?
sentences.zh: 阿塔在高中时是如何挣扎面对这一点的？

sentences.en: Because high school is a test for everyone.
sentences.zh: 因为高中对每个人来说都是一场考验。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: This is kind of that struggle with identity in kind of a Western context.
sentences.zh: 这有点像在西方语境下与身份认同的挣扎。

sentences.en: He went to the same high school as I did.
sentences.zh: 他和我上了同一所高中。

sentences.en: He was really, really effective at kind of, you know, blending in and being, you know, just like any other Kiwi.
sentences.zh: 他在融入群体、表现得像任何其他新西兰人这方面，真的、真的很有一套。

sentences.en: But also in saying that he was one to absolutely embrace his Muslim identity.
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，他也是那种绝对拥抱自己穆斯林身份的人。

sentences.en: And you kind of brought that around with him in a really effective way, in the way that it's relatable.
sentences.zh: 你以一种非常有效的方式将这一点融入生活中，以一种极具亲和力的方式。

sentences.en: So I think obviously there's a bit of a struggle to assimilation or the opposite.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，显然在同化或相反的选择上存在一些挣扎。

sentences.en: But I think for me, I'm not the most sporty person out there.
sentences.zh: 但我认为对我来说，我并不是那种最擅长运动的人。

sentences.en: And it's interesting because, I mean, everything I was interested in was not really what defined Christchurch Boys High.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我的意思是，我感兴趣的一切其实并不是克赖斯特彻奇男子高中所推崇的特质。

sentences.en: Like I did drama and debating and all these kind of more cultural things that literally no one respected.
sentences.zh: 比如我搞戏剧、辩论和所有这些更具文化色彩的事情，而根本没人尊重这些。

sentences.en: So one thing he kind of advised me was that getting into sport really does unlock doors socially.
sentences.zh: 所以他给我的建议之一就是，搞体育确实能在社交上打开局面。

sentences.en: And absolutely, in hindsight, I can completely see that he wasn't wrong.
sentences.zh: 事后回想起来，我完全能看出他说得没错。

sentences.en: And being into his sports just made him more accessible to people that he otherwise wouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 热衷于体育运动让他更容易接触到原本不会有交集的人。

sentences.en: And we often kind of discussed our high school experiences.
sentences.zh: 我们经常讨论彼此的高中经历。

sentences.en: And I've always lived through kind of his mistakes and his experiences.
sentences.zh: 我总是通过他的错误和他的经历来学习成长。

sentences.en: And he literally was like my second father.
sentences.zh: 他简直就像我的第二个父亲。

sentences.en: He'd gone through a lot of this stuff himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己经历过很多这样的事情。

sentences.en: You know, he was always teaching us from his mistakes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他总是用自己的错误来教导我们。

sentences.en: It sounds like he...
sentences.zh: 听起来他……

sentences.en: That's going to be something we're going to really miss.
sentences.zh: 这将是我们非常怀念的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm pretty stubborn in general.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我整个人挺固执的。

sentences.en: And I don't really take advice from a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我其实不怎么听取别人的建议。

sentences.en: But any time I want some advice, I'd go to him for everything.
sentences.zh: 但每当我想要什么建议时，我什么事都会去找他。

sentences.en: And he'd always have the answer for everything.
sentences.zh: 而且他总是能对所有事情都有答案。

sentences.en: And it would be the perfect answer every time.
sentences.zh: 而且每一次都会是完美的答案。

sentences.en: How do you begin to process something like this?
sentences.zh: 你该如何开始消化这样的事情？

sentences.en: I mean...
sentences.zh: 我是说……

sentences.en: Yeah, look, I'm going to be totally honest with you.
sentences.zh: 听着，我跟你说实话。

sentences.en: I think processing it is going to take a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我认为要消化这件事需要很长很长的时间。

sentences.en: I don't think we've started.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们还没开始。

sentences.en: Yeah, we haven't.
sentences.zh: 对，我们还没开始。

sentences.en: A hundred percent haven't started processing yet.
sentences.zh: 百分之百还没开始消化。

sentences.en: I mean, the first day and the second day were pretty tough.
sentences.zh: 我是说，第一天和第二天相当艰难。

sentences.en: But I think we've kind of pulled it together a little bit for the sake of mum and father.
sentences.zh: 但为了妈妈和父亲，我觉得我们多少把情绪收拢了一些。

sentences.en: But it's going to be a long, long road.
sentences.zh: 但这将是一条漫长、漫长的道路。

sentences.en: And I think things are going to come up every now and again where, I don't know, for me, it's going to be, oh, man, I want some advice.
sentences.zh: 我想总会时不时地冒出一些事情，比如，我不知道，对我来说，会变成：哦，天哪，我想听听建议了。

sentences.en: Or I want to talk to Arthur about this.
sentences.zh: 或者我想跟阿瑟聊聊这个。

sentences.en: Oh, he's not here.
sentences.zh: 哦，他不在了。

sentences.en: Kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的情形。

sentences.en: And I'm sure that's going to be years of pain for all of us.
sentences.zh: 我确信对我们所有其他人来说，这将是长达数年的痛苦。

sentences.en: I don't think there's enough words to describe what it means for them in place.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有足够的词汇来描述他在大家心中意味着什么。

sentences.en: The only reason that I'm doing architecture is because I saw one of his graphics projects pinned up on his wall.
sentences.zh: 我之所以选择学建筑，纯粹是因为我看到他的一幅平面设计图贴在墙上。

sentences.en: I mean, in hindsight, I actually kind of hated it.
sentences.zh: 说实话，事后想想，我其实有点讨厌那个设计。

sentences.en: Like, it was like this yellow Simpsons looking house.
sentences.zh: 就像是一栋黄色的《辛普森一家》风格的房子。

sentences.en: And it's pinned up on his wall.
sentences.zh: 它就贴在他的墙上。

sentences.en: And I just saw the floor plans and the sketches.
sentences.zh: 我一眼看到了平面图和草图。

sentences.en: And I was so inspired.
sentences.zh: 我受到了极大的启发。

sentences.en: And interestingly, it's something he sacrificed to stay close to home.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，为了离家近一点，他牺牲了自己的心愿。

sentences.en: He didn't want to go to Wellington to study architecture because he didn't want to be far from home.
sentences.zh: 他不想去惠灵顿学建筑，因为他不想离家太远。

sentences.en: He wanted two things.
sentences.zh: 他有两个愿望。

sentences.en: He wanted to be an architect or a dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 他想成为一名建筑师或牙医。

sentences.en: And this one's an architect.
sentences.zh: 这个成了建筑师。

sentences.en: And I'm a dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 而我是个牙医。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And Arthur put both of those dreams on hold because he didn't want to split the family up.
sentences.zh: 为了不让家庭分崩离析，阿瑟将这两个梦想都暂时搁置了。

sentences.en: Arthur stayed in Christchurch.
sentences.zh: 阿瑟留在了基督城。

sentences.en: He decided to study computer sciences.
sentences.zh: 他决定学习计算机科学。

sentences.en: And after his degree, he developed a business in app design.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，他发展了一项应用设计业务。

sentences.en: It was during this time that he met Fara.
sentences.zh: 正是在这段时间里，他遇到了法拉。

sentences.en: Arthur was an angel, honestly, not because he was my husband.
sentences.zh: 阿瑟是个天使，说真的，倒不是因为他是我的丈夫。

sentences.en: It was too good to be true.
sentences.zh: 这简直好得让人难以置信。

sentences.en: She lived in Jordan at the time.
sentences.zh: 她当时住在约旦。

sentences.en: And so they had this long-distance courtship for a while.
sentences.zh: 因此他们有一段时间进行了异地恋。

sentences.en: I felt that this was the man I want to marry.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是我想嫁的男人。

sentences.en: I was very sure that I wanted Arthur to be the father of my children.
sentences.zh: 我非常确定我想要阿瑟成为我孩子的父亲。

sentences.en: Because he had every single thing that I wanted in the man.
sentences.zh: 因为他具备了我对理想男人的所有期望。

sentences.en: So where was the wedding?
sentences.zh: 那么婚礼在哪里举行？

sentences.en: It was in Jordan.
sentences.zh: 在约旦。

sentences.en: And tell me about it.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲吧。

sentences.en: What was it like?
sentences.zh: 那是怎样的体验？

sentences.en: Oh, the best part for me was when Farah sang to him.
sentences.zh: 哦，对我来说最棒的部分是法拉为他唱歌的时候。

sentences.en: We didn't know she could sing.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道她会唱歌。

sentences.en: That's something we didn't know about her at the time.
sentences.zh: 那是当时我们对她不了解的事情。

sentences.en: And no one expected it.
sentences.zh: 而且没有人预料到这一点。

sentences.en: She kept it as a surprise.
sentences.zh: 她把这当成了一个惊喜。

sentences.en: And she walked in partway through.
sentences.zh: 她中途走了进来。

sentences.en: We heard some singing.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了一些歌声。

sentences.en: We didn't realize it was her.
sentences.zh: 我们没有意识到那是她。

sentences.en: But she walked in singing a beautiful song in Arabic and English.
sentences.zh: 但她走进来，用阿拉伯语和英语唱了一首动听的歌。

sentences.en: And she sang it to him.
sentences.zh: 她为他唱了这首歌。

sentences.en: And he cried.
sentences.zh: 然后他哭了。

sentences.en: And we all cried.
sentences.zh: 我们也都哭了。

sentences.en: And it was a beautiful moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个美好的时刻。

sentences.en: Then they had a little girl.
sentences.zh: 后来他们有了一个小女孩。

sentences.en: A baby named Aya.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫阿雅的宝宝。

sentences.en: He never sang before that.
sentences.zh: 在那之前他从未唱过歌。

sentences.en: He never sang before his daughter.
sentences.zh: 在女儿出生前他从未唱过歌。

sentences.en: I'd never heard him sing.
sentences.zh: 我从未听过他唱歌。

sentences.en: She's nearly two.
sentences.zh: 她快两岁了。

sentences.en: How do you explain to Aya what have you talked to her?
sentences.zh: 你该怎么向阿雅解释你跟她说过的话？

sentences.en: So far Aya has been busy with, you know, like a lot of children around.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，阿雅一直很忙，你知道的，周围有很多小孩子。

sentences.en: Just maybe two days ago she woke up in the middle of the night crying.
sentences.zh: 就在两天前，她半夜醒来哭泣。

sentences.en: And she was calling for her dad.
sentences.zh: 她在喊她的爸爸。

sentences.en: And then I calmed her down.
sentences.zh: 然后我把她哄安静了。

sentences.en: And she slept back.
sentences.zh: 她又睡着了。

sentences.en: And then the other day she heard the plane.
sentences.zh: 然后前几天她听到飞机声。

sentences.en: And she's like, Baba.
sentences.zh: 她就说，爸爸。

sentences.en: I'm like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我说，对呀。

sentences.en: She's like, Oakland?
sentences.zh: 她说，奥克兰？

sentences.en: Because just Monday at night he went to Oakland to where Abdullah is, his brother.
sentences.zh: 因为就在周一晚上，他去了奥克兰找他的兄弟阿卜杜拉。

sentences.en: So I'm like, yeah, Mama, Baba.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，对呀，妈妈，爸爸。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He's gone.
sentences.zh: 他走了。

sentences.en: But not to Oakland this time.
sentences.zh: 但这次不是去奥克兰。

sentences.en: He went to Jannah, which is heaven.
sentences.zh: 他去了“詹纳”，也就是天堂。

sentences.en: So for now this is what I'm going to tell her.
sentences.zh: 所以目前我打算这么告诉她。

sentences.en: That he traveled to this place.
sentences.zh: 说他去了这个地方。

sentences.en: But we can't call him and that he's gone to this place.
sentences.zh: 但我们不能给他打电话，说他去了这个地方。

sentences.en: Whereas it's heaven, not Oakland.
sentences.zh: 其实是天堂，不是奥克兰。

sentences.en: So right now we're just waiting to get the call from the police to say you can come and see the body now.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们只是在等待警方的电话，说你们现在可以来见遗体了。

sentences.en: And after that we can get started on the steps towards the burial.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们可以开始着手准备葬礼的程序。

sentences.en: And after that we're just going to wait.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们就只能等待了。

sentences.en: So two days later our photographer Adam was with the family when Abdullah got the call.
sentences.zh: 两天后，当阿卜杜拉接到电话时，我们的摄影师亚当正和这家人在一起。

sentences.en: That it was time to go and receive Atta's body.
sentences.zh: 是时候去接收阿塔的遗体了。

sentences.en: And Adam said their composure broke just for a moment.
sentences.zh: 亚当说，他们的镇定只有那么一瞬间崩溃了。

sentences.en: And they went to go and get Atta.
sentences.zh: 然后他们去接阿塔。

sentences.en: Then overnight they washed him.
sentences.zh: 接着连夜为他净身。

sentences.en: Abdullah looked after that.
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜拉负责处理这事。

sentences.en: And they shrouded him.
sentences.zh: 他们为他裹上尸布。

sentences.en: And then they went to bury him in a mass funeral with 25 others.
sentences.zh: 然后他们去参加了一个集体葬礼，与另外25人一起将他安葬。

sentences.en: I was able to attend Atta's funeral.
sentences.zh: 我得以出席阿塔的葬礼。

sentences.en: I stood in the section with the women.
sentences.zh: 我站在女宾区。

sentences.en: There were 5,000 people there.
sentences.zh: 那里有五千人。

sentences.en: Allahou Akbar, Allahou Akbar, Allahou Akbar, Allahou Akbar, Allahou Akbar.
sentences.zh: 真主至大，真主至大，真主至大，真主至大，真主至大。

sentences.en: Last week's event is proof and evidence to the entire world
sentences.zh: 上周的事件向全世界证明和昭示了

sentences.en: that terrorism has no color, has no race, and has no religion.
sentences.zh: 恐怖主义没有肤色，没有种族，也没有宗教。

sentences.en: To the people of New Zealand, thank you.
sentences.zh: 新西兰的人们，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you, thank you for your tears.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，谢谢你们的眼泪。

sentences.en: Thank you for your flowers.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们的鲜花。

sentences.en: Thank you for your love and compassion.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们的爱与同情。

sentences.en: And to all the wonderful people who have shown us that we matter
sentences.zh: 还要感谢所有向我们展现我们至关重要

sentences.en: and are not forgotten.
sentences.zh: 且并未被遗忘的伟大人们。

sentences.en: O Allah, protect New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 真主啊，请保佑新西兰。

sentences.en: O Allah, protect New Zealanders and the world.
sentences.zh: 真主啊，请保佑新西兰人民和世界。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: When the parties proceeded into the burial area, they were asked just to keep the parties small for safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 当各方队伍进入墓地时，出于安全考虑，他们被要求保持人数精简。

sentences.en: They didn't want to mix up the plots.
sentences.zh: 他们不想搞混墓地。

sentences.en: They didn't want anyone to accidentally slip and fall into a grave, and so people were asked to only bring forward the closest family to bury their loved one.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让任何人不小心滑倒摔进墓穴，因此人们被要求只让最亲近的家属上前安葬他们的挚爱。

sentences.en: They read out the lists of names in groups of five.
sentences.zh: 他们按每组五人的名单宣读名字。

sentences.en: You're used to seeing at a funeral a cluster of family around a grave.
sentences.zh: 你习惯在葬礼上看到一群家属围在墓穴周围。

sentences.en: But what was so striking here is that you saw five clusters of family around five graves, and then you had ten.
sentences.zh: 但这里最引人注目的是，你看到五组家属围着五个墓穴，然后是十个。

sentences.en: And people were trying to have this kind of private farewell where they were all circled really closely together around each grave,
sentences.zh: 人们试图进行这种私密的告别，他们紧紧地围成一圈聚在每个墓穴周围，

sentences.en: but they were so close to the other families doing the same thing.
sentences.zh: 但他们离做同样事情的其他家属又是如此之近。

sentences.en: And then they would encourage them to file out when they were finished, and they would read out the next five names.
sentences.zh: 等他们结束后，工作人员会鼓励他们排队离开，然后宣读接下来的五个名字。

sentences.en: And in the third group of five, the first name that was read out was Atas.
sentences.zh: 在第三组五人中，宣读的第一个名字是阿塔的。

sentences.en: Every five will take at a time.
sentences.zh: 每次同时处理五个人。

sentences.en: And before Atas' body was brought in,
sentences.zh: 在阿塔的遗体被运进来之前，

sentences.en: his father, who I recognised from pictures, was wheeled in in his wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 我从照片上认出的他的父亲被用轮椅推了进来。

sentences.en: He's been recovering from gunshot wounds in hospital, but obviously he was able to come out for his son's funeral.
sentences.zh: 他一直在医院里从枪伤中恢复，但显然他能够出席儿子的葬礼。

sentences.en: He was all in black, and he just waited by the grave.
sentences.zh: 他一身黑衣，静静地在墓旁等候。

sentences.en: And then the women filed in a little way behind him,
sentences.zh: 随后女眷们在他身后不远处排队走了进来，

sentences.en: Farah and Maysoon, Atas' mum,
sentences.zh: 法拉和阿塔的母亲梅苏恩，

sentences.en: Hanin, his sister, and some other relatives, and they were all supporting each other and holding on to each other.
sentences.zh: 他的妹妹哈宁以及其他一些亲戚，她们互相扶持，紧紧抓着彼此。

sentences.en: And then Atas' body was brought in, and I knew it was him because I could see Abdallah among those carrying the coffin.
sentences.zh: 接着阿塔的遗体被运了进来，我知道是他，因为我看到阿卜杜拉在抬棺的人当中。

sentences.en: They had these open coffins with low sides, so you could see the shrouded body inside.
sentences.zh: 他们使用的是那种低边露顶的棺材，所以你可以看到里面包裹着尸布的遗体。

sentences.en: And then Atas' dad, Muhammad,
sentences.zh: 然后，阿塔的父亲穆罕默德

sentences.en: supporting himself on a cane, got out of the wheelchair and stood by the grave as Atas' body was lowered in.
sentences.zh: 拄着拐杖从轮椅上站起来，在阿塔的遗体被缓缓放下的同时站立在墓旁。

sentences.en: And everyone had their hands on him, it seemed like everyone had a hand on his back.
sentences.zh: 每个人都把手放在他身上，似乎每个人都有一只手搭在他的背上。

sentences.en: And they were all supporting each other.
sentences.zh: 他们都在互相支持。

sentences.en: And they all just stood there for a long time, surrounded by all of these other families doing the same.
sentences.zh: 他们都在那里站了很久，周围是所有做着同样事情的其他家属。

sentences.en: And the sheikh sang,
sentences.zh: 谢赫唱道，

sentences.en: Allahu Akbar,
sentences.zh: 真主至大，

sentences.en: God is great, before the bodies were lowered.
sentences.zh: 真主伟大，在遗体被放下之前。

sentences.en: Allahu Akbar!
sentences.zh: 真主至大！

sentences.en: They picked up their shovels, and they started to shovel earth into the grave.
sentences.zh: 他们拿起铁锹，开始往墓穴里填土。

sentences.en: And Abdullah, Atas' brother,
sentences.zh: 阿塔的兄弟阿卜杜拉

sentences.en: was going around and giving everyone hugs, but these really completely stock still hugs.
sentences.zh: 四处走动，给每个人一个拥抱，但这些拥抱真的完全一动不动。

sentences.en: He would hold each person, and they would just stand really still for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他拥抱每一个人，他们就这样一动不动地站了很久。

sentences.en: Then a floral arrangement was placed on the grave.
sentences.zh: 随后一个花篮被放在了墓上。

sentences.en: And the men filed out, they still had their hands on each other's backs.
sentences.zh: 男士们排队离开，他们的手依然搭在彼此的背上。

sentences.en: The women came to the grave for a moment, and stood there too.
sentences.zh: 女眷们也来到墓前停留了一会儿，静静伫立。

sentences.en: Outside the burial area were waiting,
sentences.zh: 在墓地外面等待的是，

sentences.en: Atas' football teammates.
sentences.zh: 阿塔的足球队友们。

sentences.en: They filed out, and then the next group of bodies was brought in.
sentences.zh: 他们排队离开，接着下一组遗体被运了进来。

sentences.en: And that kept happening until the funeral was over.
sentences.zh: 这种情况一直持续到葬礼结束。

sentences.en: Not long after I got home, I got a text from Abdullah, and he just wanted to make sure I'd made it into the funeral okay.
sentences.zh: 我回家没多久，就收到了阿卜杜拉发来的一条短信，他只是想确认我是否顺利参加完了葬礼。

sentences.en: I told him I had, and then I asked him how he was doing.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他我顺利参加了，然后我问他最近怎么样。

sentences.en: And he replied,
sentences.zh: 他回复道，

sentences.en: All I can say is that I feel at peace.
sentences.zh: 我能说的是，我感到内心平静。

sentences.en: We haven't lost everything.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有失去一切。

sentences.en: We still have each other, and we're going to have to get through it together.
sentences.zh: 我们还有彼此，我们将不得不一起度过难关。

sentences.en: There's no other choice.
sentences.zh: 别无选择。

sentences.en: You know, life has to go on.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，生活必须继续。

sentences.en: You've got to keep living.
sentences.zh: 你必须继续生活下去。

sentences.en: We do have faith, even if it's maybe not quite as strong as my dad's faith.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有信仰，尽管也许没有我父亲的信仰那么坚定。

sentences.en: We do have faith.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有信仰。

sentences.en: We believe in the afterlife.
sentences.zh: 我们相信来世。

sentences.en: We believe he's in a better place, and we want to meet him there.
sentences.zh: 我们相信他在一个更好的地方，我们希望在那里与他重逢。

sentences.en: So I just hope that, inshallah, one day we'll be again reunited in Jannah, in heaven.
sentences.zh: 所以我只希望，安拉意愿，有一天我们会在詹纳，在天堂里再次团聚。

sentences.en: And this is what will give me the strength, you know, to continue our dreams and goals that we could not achieve together, and that we have already set.
sentences.zh: 这就是给予我力量的东西，你知道的，去延续我们未能共同实现、但我们已经设定好的梦想和目标。

sentences.en: And I'm going to raise our daughter to know who her father was, be very proud of her father, and, yeah, I love him.
sentences.zh: 我要抚养我们的女儿，让她知道她的父亲是谁，为她的父亲感到非常骄傲，而且，是的，我爱他。

sentences.en: We'll always do.
sentences.zh: 我们永远都会。

sentences.en: Ata Aleian was 33 years old.
sentences.zh: 阿塔·阿莱扬年仅33岁。

sentences.en: Officials in New Zealand now say that all 50 victims of the shooting have been identified and buried.
sentences.zh: 新西兰官员现在表示，枪击事件的所有50名受害者都已被确认身份并安葬。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，享受30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, The Times found that the report submitted by special counsel Robert Mueller was more than 300 pages long,
sentences.zh: 周四，《时报》发现特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒提交的报告长达300多页，

sentences.en: suggesting that Mueller went well beyond the bare-bones summary required by law and offered a detailed explanation of his conclusions.
sentences.zh: 这表明穆勒远远超出了法律要求的简要总结，并对其结论提供了详细的解释。

sentences.en: No, thank you, Mr. Attorney General.
sentences.zh: 不，谢谢你，总检察长先生。

sentences.en: We do not need your interpretation.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要你的解读。

sentences.en: Show us the report and we can draw our own conclusions.
sentences.zh: 把报告给我们看，我们可以得出我们自己的结论。

sentences.en: So far, those conclusions have been summarized in a four-page document by the Attorney General,
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这些结论已被总检察长总结在一份四页的文件中，

sentences.en: William Barr, fueling calls, especially from Democrats, for him to release the full report to both Congress and the public.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔，这引发了各方（尤其是民主党人）的要求，要求他向国会和公众公布完整报告。

sentences.en: We don't need you interpreting for us.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要你来为我们解读。

sentences.en: It was condescending, it was arrogant, and it wasn't the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是屈尊俯就的，这是傲慢的，而且这不是正确做法。

sentences.en: So the sooner they can give us the information, the sooner we can all make a judgment about it.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们能越快把信息给我们，我们就能越快对它做出判断。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court has ruled that a ban imposed by the Trump administration on bump stocks, a device that allows semi-automatic rifles to fire more like automatic rifles,
sentences.zh: 最高法院裁定，特朗普政府对撞火枪托（一种能让半自动步枪像全自动步枪那样发射的装置）实施的禁令

sentences.en: can remain in place.
sentences.zh: 可以继续保留。

sentences.en: Under the ban, which was put in place after a bump stock was used in a mass shooting in Las Vegas, it is illegal to sell or possess bump stocks,
sentences.zh: 根据这项在拉斯维加斯大规模枪击案中使用撞火枪托后出台的禁令，出售或持有撞火枪托是违法的，

sentences.en: and those who currently own them have 90 days to either destroy them or turn them over to the government.
sentences.zh: 而目前拥有它们的人有90天的时间来销毁它们或将其交予政府。

sentences.en: The Daily is produced by Theo Balcom,
sentences.zh: 《每日秀》由西奥·巴尔科姆制作，

sentences.en: Lindsay Garrison,
sentences.zh: 琳赛·加里森，

sentences.en: Rachel Quester,
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔·奎斯特，

sentences.en: Annie Brown,
sentences.zh: 安妮·布朗，

sentences.en: Andy Mills,
sentences.zh: 安迪·米尔斯，

sentences.en: Claire Tennesketter,
sentences.zh: 克莱尔·特内斯凯特，

sentences.en: Michael Simon-Johnson,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊，

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年以来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人激动的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
